findings.evidence: "Parallel workers committing in one checkout race on the git index: serialize commits, or give each worker its own paths and have it commit only those (`git commit -- <paths>`)." The second branch does not eliminate concurrency conflicts: disjoint-path commits still share the index, HEAD and their locks.
findings.fix: Replace this instruction with: Parallel workers share one index and HEAD even when editing disjoint files. Serialize commits and other index/HEAD mutations in a shared checkout. Use `git commit -- <paths>` only to constrain commit contents, not as an alternative to serialization; parallel commits require isolated worktrees.
